description.value:
You've secured a piece of the fabled power possessed by the antlered monarchs of the hunt in the form of one of their gnarled hunting horns. If the horn is on your person during your daily preparations, you can choose up to three additional allied creatures as your hunting partners, who remain so until you choose new hunting partners or the horn is lost or destroyed. These additional hunting partners benefit from your wild hunter feats as your normal hunting partner would.

If your horn is lost or destroyed, it takes 1 week to find or create a new one.
